items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Failed plain commands no longer produce an error card or reconcile sentence; subrunner glyph is line-size; no transcript view built.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Generic is_error now continues without mutating the card; user-input, test and subrunner error paths are unchanged.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input surfaces; raw error output is no longer rendered at all, only test-failure detail as inert text (covered by ContentSafety test).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Blocker tests were rewritten to assert absence (no error/blocker/recovery text, no err status); e2e flipped to assert absence; full vitest 4502 pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Pure removal of reducer branches; no new loops.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: attachDetail moved to missionActivityFeedDetail.ts; all touched files < 300 lines except pre-existing ones that shrank.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the feed is derived on the fly from the transcript, nothing persisted with kind blocker.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene --diff reports only missing_file for the two deliberately deleted blocker test files; no skip/only introduced.
